title: 第11章 我真该死啊第12章 契约墨玉狐
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
那巴掌是她自己扇的。
“我真该死啊！”
“唰”的一声，怀中大鹅被女孩撕的粉碎。
“她已经这么惨了，我还这么说她。”
“呜呜呜~”
“不行，我要再去深渊杀几个魔崽子消消火！”
女孩翻身而起，在大床上拍了一掌。
只见那华丽大床在短短两秒内变成了一把比女孩身高还要高出一大半的巨斧。
她握着那斧身比她腰还宽不少的巨斧，轻松抗在肩头，朝门外走去。
姑娘刚刚出门没一会，一阵压的极低的交谈声在营帐内响起。
“我去，暴龙姐才回来多久？怎么又出去了？”
“不知道啊！”
“不过我能肯定的是，前线有人要遭殃了！”
-----------------
陈小草再次出现在孤儿院的时候，是推着一个小板车进来的。
手里的六万现金，她只预留了一万块应急，其他的全都换成了物资。
八小只绕着陈小草的板车跳来跳去，一双双小眼睛在陈小草和板车上的物资只见来回游移。
院长奶奶脸上露出了久违的笑容。
阳光洒在她苍老的脸颊上，那深深的沟壑看起来也柔和了不少。

板车刚停稳，男孩子们就迫不及待的帮忙卸货。
女孩则是给陈小草端来了凉水和毛巾。
一声声清脆的‘小草姐姐’，让陈小草的嘴角不由自主的扬起来几分。
一起卸完了货物，陈小草拿腔拿调的喊了一声。
“集合！”
八小只歪歪扭扭站成了一排，一个个挺起胸膛，小脑袋昂的高高的，像是正在等待检阅的士兵。
陈小草看着他们脑袋上乱飞的呆毛，有些想笑。
她变戏法似得从怀里掏出来八根糖葫芦。
“鉴于你们优秀的表现，今天，我将给与你们孤儿院最高的奖赏。”
“每人一根糖葫芦！”
“哦~”
“有糖葫芦吃咯！”
八小只双眼绽放着渴望的光。
看着陈小草一根根把糖葫芦发到了他们的手里。
糖葫芦到手，他们尽管嘴角都开始溢出晶莹的口水，可依旧没有开吃。
反而一个个看着陈小草。
年纪最小的小花，明显看糖葫芦的时间更多一些。

That slap was given by herself.
"I'm so damned good!"
With a "swish" sound, the goose in her arms was torn to pieces by the girl.
"She is already so miserable, and I still say this to her."
"Woooooo~"
"No, I want to go to the abyss to kill a few more demon cubs to put out the fire!"
The girl stood up and slapped her hands on the big bed.
The gorgeous bed turned into a giant ax that was more than half the girl's height in just two seconds.
She held the huge ax whose body was much wider than her waist, put it on her shoulders easily, and walked towards the door.
Not long after the girl went out, a low-pitched conversation sounded in the tent.
"I'll go, how long has it been since Sister Tyrannosaurus came back? Why did she go out again?"
"I don't know!"
"But what I am sure of is that someone on the front line is going to suffer!"
------------------
When Chen Xiaocao appeared at the orphanage again, he came in pushing a small cart.
Of the 60,000 yuan in cash in her hand, she only reserved 10,000 yuan for emergencies, and the rest was replaced with supplies.
The eight little ones jumped around Chen Xiaocao's cart, their little eyes darting back and forth between Chen Xiaocao and the materials on the cart.
A long-lost smile appeared on Grandma Dean’s face.
The sun shone on her old cheeks, and the deep ravines looked much softer.
As soon as the truck stopped, the boys couldn't wait to help unload the goods.
The girl brought Chen Xiaocao cold water and a towel.
The crisp words of 'Sister Xiaocao' made Chen Xiaocao's lips raise involuntarily.
After unloading the goods together, Chen Xiaocao shouted in a good tone.
"Assemble!"
The eight little ones stood crookedly in a row, each with their chests puffed out and their little heads held high, like soldiers waiting for a review.
Chen Xiaocao looked at the silly hairs flying around their heads and wanted to laugh.
She pulled out eight candied haws from her arms as if by magic.
"In view of your outstanding performance, today, I will give you the highest reward in the orphanage."
"One candied haws for each person!"
"Oh~"
“There’s some candied haws to eat!”
The eight small eyes glowed with desire.
Watching Chen Xiaocao hand out the candied haws to their hands one by one.
When they got the candied haws, although glistening saliva began to flow from the corners of their mouths, they still didn't eat it.
Instead, everyone looked at Chen Xiaocao.
Xiaohua, the youngest, obviously spends more time looking at the candied haws.
